newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Atomic Power set to restart nuclear reactor.
newsitem.headline: Japan Atomic Power set to restart nuclear reactor.

text.p: Japan Atomic Power Co said on Tuesday its 1.16 million kilowatt reactor, shut since late December after leaking cooling water, would resume power generation later in the day.
"Necessary checks and measures have been taken," a company spokesman said.
The Tsuruga No. 2 reactor, on the Japan Sea coast, was manually stopped on December 24 to make emergency checks into a leakage of cooling water.
There had been no radiation leaks as a result of the incident, the company said.
